description: SO(9) BMN Q-cohomology on SU(3)_R highest-weight vectors at level j = 22: ALL 16 dominant columns, every nonempty 2J (79 sectors), fortuity.hwcoh.run_sectors format (m = exact hw multiplicity, r_up = rank of Q from 2J to 2J+1, grav = multi-graviton hw classes modulo exact, check = self-check; h(n) = m(n) - r_up(n-1) - r_up(n)). Result: 320 multiplets, 319 multi-graviton, exactly 1 non-graviton: the R-006 class, [2,0] at (1;5,3,3). T-044.
computed_by: Fortuity collaboration (Claude agent), laptop, 2026-10-06 (4 processes, 214 s; largest m = 1043)
code: code/fortuity/hwcoh (run_sectors, numpy engine, GROUP=SO_odd, N=4, SEED=1, default GEN_NMAX = 8 = 2N, the top Casimir degree); exact multiplicities from hwcoh.dims.partition_dims_nf(4, 22, group='SO_odd', workers=8) (not stored; regenerated in 6 min)

checked: (i) per-sector self-check in all 79 sectors; (ii) completeness by enumeration: the 79 (column, 2J) sectors with letter content at j = 22 (fortuity.bmn.words.contents_of_sector) are exactly the ones present; (iii) Euler characteristic = exact refined BMN index (fortuity.bmn.groupindex via scripts/bmn/so-usp-g2-scans/euler_check.py) in all 16 columns (2026-10-06); (iv) the (5,3,3) column equals R-018's positive control data/so_sp/so9_hw_cohomology_533_j22_control.jsonl sector by sector (m, r_up, grav; that run used GEN_NMAX = 10 on Torch), and a second seed (SEED = 2, so9_hw_cohomology_j22_seed2_533.jsonl) gives identical m, r_up, grav; (v) weighting each column's 2J = 0, 1, 2 class and graviton counts by the multiplicity of the weight (5,3,3) in that irrep (Kostka numbers) gives 0, 429 (428 graviton), 0: R-006's weight-space table (fortuity.bmn.symdirect) by an independent method.
